P = ctypes.c_void_p; I = ctypes.c_int; Fl = ctypes.c_float
class Params(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [(n, P) for n in "x dww dwb lnw lnb w1 b1 gw gb w2 b2 out xn part hidden sumsq w1h w2h".split()] + \
               [(n, I) for n in "B C H W HW M Mp C4 nch".split()] + [("eps", Fl), ("ln_eps", Fl)] + \

lib.convnext_launch.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
lib.convnext_launch.argtypes = [Params, P, I]
def al(v): return (v + 255) // 256 * 256
def run(x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, eps, lneps, out, mode=0, mask=7, force_split=0):
    B, C, H, W = x.shape; HW = H*W; M = B*HW; C4 = 4*C; nch = C//32; Mp = (M+127)//128*128
    o_xn = 0; o_part = al(C*Mp*4); o_hid = al(o_part + nch*Mp*8); o_sq = al(o_hid + C4*Mp*2)
    o_w1 = al(o_sq + B*C4*4); o_w2 = al(o_w1 + C*C4*2); tot = al(o_w2 + C*C4*2)
    ws = torch.empty(tot, dtype=torch.uint8, device=x.device); wp = ws.data_ptr()
    p = Params()
    for n, t in zip("x dww dwb lnw lnb w1 b1 gw gb w2 b2 out".split(), [x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, out]):
        setattr(p, n, t.data_ptr())
    p.xn = wp + o_xn; p.part = wp + o_part; p.hidden = wp + o_hid; p.sumsq = wp + o_sq; p.w1h = wp + o_w1; p.w2h = wp + o_w2
    p.B, p.C, p.H, p.W, p.HW, p.M, p.Mp, p.C4, p.nch = B, C, H, W, HW, M, Mp, C4, nch
    p.eps = eps; p.ln_eps = lneps; p.mask = mask; p.force_split = force_split
    err = lib.convnext_launch(p, torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream, mode)
    if err: raise RuntimeError(err)
def gen(B, C, H, W, seed=0):
    g = torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(seed)
    r = lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda', generator=g)
    x = r(B, C, H, W); dww = r(C, 1, 7, 7) / math.sqrt(7); dwb = r(C)
    lnw = torch.ones(C, device='cuda'); lnb = torch.zeros(C, device='cuda')
    w1 = r(4*C, C) / math.sqrt(C); b1 = r(4*C); gw = r(1, 1, 1, 4*C) / math.sqrt(4*C); gb = r(1, 1, 1, 4*C)
    w2 = r(C, 4*C) / math.sqrt(4*C); b2 = r(C)
    return [x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, 1e-6, 1e-6]
def ref(x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, eps, lneps):
    C = x.shape[1]
    h = F.conv2d(x, dww, dwb, padding=3, groups=C).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
    h = F.layer_norm(h, (C,), lnw, lnb, lneps)
    h = F.gelu(F.linear(h, w1, b1))
    gx = torch.norm(h, p=2, dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True); nx = gx / (gx.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    h = gw * (h * nx) + gb + h
    return x + F.linear(h, w2, b2).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
def check(shape, atol=2.4e-3, **kw):
    inp = gen(*shape); out = torch.zeros_like(inp[0])
    run(*inp, out, **kw); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    with torch.no_grad():
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False; torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
        rf = ref(*inp)
    d = (out - rf).abs()
    return d.max().item(), (d > atol + 1e-5 * rf.abs()).float().mean().item(), (d.pow(2).mean().sqrt().item())
def tm(shape, **kw):
    inp = gen(*shape); out = torch.zeros_like(inp[0])
    return b200probe.harness_time(lambda *a: run(*a, **kw), inp, [out])
